truth_rules: A Git commit ID is not an image file hash.
A Git blob ID identifies exact Git object bytes.
A SHA-256 fingerprint must be tied to the exact file version it was calculated from.
Visually identical images may have different hashes after resizing, recompression, screenshots, Photos, or messaging apps.
A matching hash proves byte identity, not that the visual content was intact before commit.
Repository provenance does not equal blockchain minting.
Do not claim an NFT is minted, transferred, signed, or on-chain without independently verifiable network evidence.

corrections.correct: It is a Git commit ID, not the image hash.

canonical_rule: Preserve evidence, preserve corrections, separate repository proof from blockchain proof, and never upgrade an unverified claim into a verified event.
